decisions.executionNote: Remember left-to-right colors: blue, red, green. Begin elbow-up left-arm approach to the leftmost cover, gripper open; conservative rotation increments.
Align left link6 above the first cup with tool axis downward, then begin descent. Left block is blue; center red; right green.
Descend to the first cup's side-grasp height, close fully, pause, and make a small test lift. Retention must be checked visually.
Cup appears retained. Lift clear, translate toward the left blue block, then lower without changing cup orientation; keep gripper closed.
Seat the first cup over blue, release it, and withdraw vertically before approaching the middle cover. Preserve the cup's orientation.
First block is visually covered. Move the open left gripper above the middle cup with clearance; right arm remains parked.
Grasp the middle cup at the observed alignment and test-lift it. Keep full closure during retention; do not disturb the first cover.
Middle cup appears retained. Lift clear of the red block, translate to its position, then lower the cup with unchanged orientation, keeping it closed.
Seat and release the middle cup over red, then raise the left hand. Begin an elbow-up right-arm approach to the final cup, staying in the right workspace.
First two covers remain seated. Align the right gripper downward above the last cup and begin a cautious descent; left waits above the red cover without contact.
Descend to the rightmost cup's side-grasp height, close fully, pause, and test-lift. Keep the two already-covered blocks undisturbed.
The right cup appears retained. Lift, carry it over the right green block, and lower without rotating. This is the third covering step; left remains clear of the red cover.
Finish seating and release the third cover over green. With the left-to-right covering sequence finished, descend to grasp the middle red cover; do not lift it until the third cover is seated.
All three blocks now appear covered. Uncover red first by lifting the middle cup and carrying it forward to a clear resting spot; green and blue remain covered.
Set the red cover down in front of its block and release. Approach and grasp the right green cover, but keep it seated until red's removal is visually confirmed; blue remains untouched.
Withdraw the left hand from the set-down cup to clear the view of red, then wait above the blue cover without touching it. Keep green's cover seated until the red block is visible.
Red is visibly uncovered. Uncover green second by lifting and moving the right cup forward. Prepare a seated grasp of the blue cover, without lifting blue yet.
Green is visible after red. Uncover blue last by lifting its cup and moving it forward. Set down and release the green cup with its orientation unchanged.
Blue is now visible after red and green. Set down its cover, release, and withdraw; begin a gradual elbow-up return of the empty right arm toward origin.
All cups are set down and all colors are exposed. Return both empty arms along continuous elbow-up paths; right approaches its origin while left retracts with clearance.
Complete the continuous left-arm return to its initial pose and settle the right arm at origin. Keep both grippers open and leave the exposed blocks and upright covers undisturbed.
